summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (placed after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, added numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and created tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so tests and the 120-column limit are unverified. Not covered by tests: the batch-coupling case (expected ~0.333), max-normalization, and the non-square ValueError. Also, wasserstein_distance_map casts the stored matrix to the logits' dtype and device with .to(flat_proba), so numpy float64 matrices work with float32 logits. No commits were made.
